name: ghostforge-jarvis
description: GhostForge JARVIS — Ultimate AI Desktop Assistant with Screen Vision, Voice Control, and Blue Cursor

scripts.build:mac: node scripts/generate-icons.js && tsc && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never
scripts.build:win: node scripts/generate-icons.js && tsc && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/generate-icons.js && tsc && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --linux rpm --x64 --publish never
